arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with strong, energetic hooks; experimental arrangement using various chop techniques.

channels.name: micro_chops
channels.description: Micro-sliced vocal and instrument snippet chops

channels.name: phrase_chops

channels.name: reverse_chops

sound_intent.description: Create a cinematic atmospheric phonk track with experimental chopping techniques for texture variation and dynamic energy shifts.

routing_intent.description: Route chopped sample layers to individual channels named after their chop technique to maintain clarity and allow detailed mixing.

track_roles.drums: Provide rhythmic foundation with sparse patterns supporting hooks.
track_roles.bass: Subtle low-end complement keeping verses sparse.
track_roles.chords: Add harmonic texture with chopped samples.
track_roles.vocal: Lead vocal chops creating hooks and textures.
track_roles.fx: Atmospheric accents and transitions using chopped effects.

designer_intent.general: Focus on cinematic feel, experimental textures, and balance between sparse verses and energetic hooks.

presetor_intent.general: Design presets that emphasize clarity on chopped samples and smooth transitions between sections.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate sparse yet solid phonk drum patterns that complement hook sections without overcrowding the mix.

bass_generator.brief: Create low-end basslines that are subtle during verses but support the energy peaks in hooks.

harmony_generator.brief: Develop harmonic content with chopped chords that maintain cinematic mood and experimental texture.

melody_generator.brief: Produce minimal melodic elements emphasizing hook sections while keeping verses sparse.

ai_designer.brief: Shape overall arrangement and dynamics for cinematic, experimental phonk with emphasis on chopping techniques.

presetor.brief: Apply suitable presets to sample layers to enhance texture and clarity of chop techniques.

songgps.brief: Coordinate arrangement flow ensuring energy curve aligns with sparse verses and strong hooks in defined sections.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix with focus on clear separation of chop technique channels and preserving cinematic mood.
